items.title: Dave Liebman — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: [INTERVIEWER] You did Lookout Farm. I want to talk about that for a moment, because later Chuck Berg worked on a book of that music.

ctx.x: Anyway, that’s a lot of by-products of that, the lack of work, but that’s one of them. It’s a subtle thing.
You did Lookout Farm. I want to talk about that for a moment, because later Chuck Berg worked on a book of that music.

Yeah, small group improvisation, one-of-a-kind book. Great book, too. It was us talking about the process. We had a very good relationship, Richie, Frank, and Jeff. It was like a rock band in that vibe, in a certain way. We talked. Every night we came back with the tape, and we listened religiously to the tape. We’d fall asleep.
